declaredTypes.statement: GroundMissileLauncherFireSystem is an unmanaged ISystem that advances launcher phases and creates missile projectiles.
GroundMissileLauncherVisualSystem, GroundMissileFlyingRocketVisualSystem, and GroundMissileRocketTrailSystem project launcher and rocket presentation state.
GroundMissileProjectileFlightSystem and its Burst IJobChunk advance simulation projectiles and emit impact requests.
GroundMissileImpactSystem consumes impact requests and resolves combat damage and feedback requests.

inputs.statement: Fire reads launcher configuration, mutable launcher phase state including target world position, launcher/rocket transforms, faction, and elapsed time; dead launchers are excluded.
Visual projection reads launcher configuration/state, launcher transforms, visual references, and rocket visual buffers.
Projectile flight reads and writes GroundMissileProjectileComponent and LocalTransform through cached type handles.
Impact resolution reads GroundMissileImpactRequestComponent plus target health, transforms, faction, and optional damage-observation queue state.

outputs.statement: Fire creates the projectile and interception target, records GroundMissileInFlightComponent on the launcher, and removes EngageTarget.
Visual systems update battery and rocket LocalTransform state and restore rocket parent/visibility when the launch visual finishes.
Projectile completion adds GroundMissileImpactRequestComponent and removes flight and interception components.
Impact resolution updates direct and area UnitHealth, recent-damage state, removes launcher in-flight state, and destroys the consumed request entity.

stateAuthority.statement: UnitAttackSystem arms the canonical launcher state as Preparing; Fire then owns the Preparing, Launching, Reloading, and Idle phase transitions and timer reset.
Visual systems are projection authorities only: they derive battery pose, slot visibility, and temporary rocket pose from launcher and flying-visual state.
Projectile flight owns elapsed trajectory state until it hands one one-shot impact request component to impact resolution.
Impact owns consumption of GroundMissileImpactRequestComponent and the resulting health and recent-attacker mutations; it does not retain persistent system state.

updateOrder.statement: Fire runs after UnitAttackSystem so attack intent is available before phase advancement and projectile creation.
The local sequence is Fire, launcher Visual, Flying Rocket Visual, Rocket Trail, Projectile Flight, then Impact.
Both parallel jobs complete before their ECB playback, making structural handoffs visible to the following ordered system in the same frame.

sideEffects.statement: Launch and impact emit config-driven combat audio event requests through the audio event boundary.
Launch and impact enqueue managed VFX presentation requests; the trail system synchronizes the missile trail view.
Impact appends combat-damage observations for direct and area hits for downstream telemetry and presentation.

failureBehavior.statement: Missing rocket buffers, battery entities, transforms, or VFX references fail as bounded no-ops rather than creating invalid presentation state.
Projectile duration, speed, timers, damage, radius, and visible scale are clamped to prevent divide-by-zero, negative damage, and zero-scale instability.
Direct damage is skipped for null, missing, non-health, friendly, dead, or zero-damage targets; area damage excludes static blockers, friendly/dead units, and targets outside the radius.

GroundMissileLauncherPhase declares Recovering, but the fire update has no Recovering branch; characterization must define whether legacy Recovering state transitions or fails closed before extraction.
GroundMissileInFlightComponent is cleared only when an impact request is consumed; interception or external projectile removal requires explicit launcher cleanup or it can leave attack gating stale.

tests.statement: GroundMissileLauncherRuntimeTests provides focused EditMode behavior coverage; run it through the Unity Test Framework EditMode filter.
GroundMissileLauncherPlayModeTests covers the runtime scene flow; run it through the Unity Test Framework PlayMode filter.

Run Tools/CI/invoke_unity_macos.sh --timeout 600 --log /private/tmp/am010-ground-missile-performance.log -- -quit -executeMethod GroundMissileAttackPerformanceValidation.RunBatchValidation for the current 16-warmup/64-measurement timing fixture.

allowedDependencies.statement: Allowed dependencies are unmanaged Unity ECS, Burst, Collections, Mathematics, Transforms, and neutral Game.Components data contracts already imported by the owner.
Narrow same-assembly runtime boundaries are allowed for combat audio requests, damage observations, and VFX requests; calls must remain explicit and data-oriented.

forbiddenDependencies.statement: Do not introduce UI, bootstrap, scene lookup, singleton service location, reflection, or manager/controller/facade dependencies into missile simulation.

Do not replace these unmanaged ISystem and Burst job boundaries with SystemBase or MonoBehaviour simulation ownership; the current direct MissileTrailVfxView call is legacy architecture debt that must move behind an ECS presentation request.
Do not retain Temp or TempJob containers across frames; each system owns completion, playback, and disposal of its local command buffer.

boundedExtractionCandidates.statement: Extract only the missile-trail presentation bridge: publish explicit ECS trail-sync data from GroundMissileRocketTrailSystem and consume it in a documented managed presentation boundary; retain launch phases, projectile simulation, impact damage, and all other presentation requests in their current owners.
boundedExtractionCandidates.authorityBoundary: GroundMissileRocketTrailSystem owns production of transient sync requests; the managed presentation system owns request consumption only; MissileTrailVfxView retains pooled trail create/update/release state.
boundedExtractionCandidates.proposedUpdateOrder: GroundMissileRocketTrailSystem produces after flying-rocket visual update; MissileTrailSyncPresentationSystem consumes afterward in presentation order and destroys only consumed request entities.
boundedExtractionCandidates.cleanupAuthority: MissileTrailSyncPresentationSystem consumes transient requests; MissileTrailVfxView retains its two-missing-frame release, explicit Release, and ClearAll lifecycle until separately characterized.

declaredTypes.statement: UnitTransportBoardingSystem is an unmanaged ISystem in SimulationSystemGroup that performs the automatic boarding-completion tick.
BoardingDecisionKind and BoardingDecision represent the bounded decision handoff between parallel read evaluation and main-thread mutation.
CollectBoardingDecisionsJob is a Burst IJobEntity that excludes disabled passengers and evaluates transport validity, capacity, landed state, and reach.

inputs.statement: The required passenger query reads UnitTransportBoardingTarget, UnitGrid, and LocalTransform and excludes Disabled passengers.
Transport and passenger lookups cover seat/cargo capacity, passenger buffers and kind metadata, grid/footprint/transforms, air and door state, rope requests, and movement progress.
Optional GridConfig supports resolved plane-ramp reach while diagnostics state gates queued feedback.

outputs.statement: Invalid transports and full capacity cancel UnitTransportBoardingTarget; not-landed and not-reached decisions preserve the request and may reissue movement.
A stopped ground passenger receives a target/path move order, manual move tags, and loses path retry cooldown.
Ready decisions revalidate transport and capacity, then delegate the successful passenger-state mutation to UnitTransportPassengerStateSystem before ECB playback.

stateAuthority.statement: This owner controls current-target validation, landed/reach evaluation, capacity revalidation, cancellation, retry, and the final boarding handoff, but does not author the initial boarding command.
UnitTransportPassengerStateSystem remains the authority for onboard passenger mutation; this system delegates BoardPassenger rather than duplicating that state transition.
The system owns its lookup/query caches and temporary decision list/ECB lifecycle, updating lookups every frame and disposing temporary state before return.

updateOrder.statement: UnitTransportBoardingSystem runs in SimulationSystemGroup after UnitGridMovementSystem, so reach decisions observe movement from the current simulation tick.
The collection job is scheduled from state.Dependency and synchronously completed before diagnostics, cancellation, retry, or boarding mutations.
Main-thread transport/capacity revalidation occurs immediately before BoardPassenger, and all deferred structural mutations play back once at update end.

sideEffects.statement: Diagnostics may create/use a diagnostic queue and append cancellation, waiting, or boarded records; waiting feedback is throttled to every 180 rendered frames.
Boarding presentation and passenger disablement are indirect side effects of the delegated BoardPassenger boundary, not direct managed-object mutation in this system.
The owner performs one explicit ECB playback; it contains no direct Debug.Log, object instantiate/destroy, or scene lookup call.

failureBehavior.statement: Missing transport, capacity, passenger buffer, grid, footprint, or transform produces TransportMissingOrInvalid and cancels the request.
Air transports wait unless air state exists, flight/rolling flags are clear, physical height is grounded, and no rope disembark is active.
Unknown passenger kinds normalize to soldier, capacities/cargo weights clamp nonnegative, and missing GridConfig falls back to footprint, goal, world-distance, and cell-distance reach checks.
Dead passenger-buffer entries are ignored and transport existence/capacity are rechecked on the main thread before boarding to reject stale job decisions.
The optional GridConfig path assumes at most one matching entity because it calls GetSingletonEntity; AM-011 must characterize or guard the multiple-grid case before extraction.
Passenger occupancy counts every live matching buffer entry and does not deduplicate entities; duplicate entries therefore consume duplicate capacity and require an explicit invariant test.

tests.statement: Run Tools/CI/invoke_unity_macos.sh --timeout 600 --log /private/tmp/am010-unit-transport.log -- -quit -executeMethod UnitTransportValidationTests.RunBatchValidation for focused ground, cargo, landed-state, reach, ramp, and architecture coverage.

Run Tools/CI/invoke_unity_macos.sh --timeout 600 --log /private/tmp/am010-boarding-performance.log -- -quit -executeMethod TransportBoardingPerformanceValidation.RunBatchValidation for the current 16-warmup/64-measurement fixture.

Run Tools/CI/invoke_unity_macos.sh --timeout 600 --log /private/tmp/am010-boarding-playmode.log -- -quit -runTests -testPlatform PlayMode -testFilter GameSceneTransportBoardingPlayModeTests -testResults /private/tmp/am010-boarding-playmode.xml for scene-flow boarding coverage.
UnitTransportBoardingSystemExtractionTests characterizes passenger-kind and capacity/occupancy rules relevant to the proposed extraction.

allowedDependencies.statement: Allowed dependencies are unmanaged Unity ECS, Burst, Collections, Jobs, Mathematics, Transforms, and neutral Game.Components data contracts already imported by the owner.
Narrow same-assembly runtime boundaries are allowed for diagnostics, move-order application, footprint/grid math, and passenger-state mutation; inputs remain explicit.
UnityEngine.Time.frameCount is an active managed dependency used only to throttle optional diagnostics; it is not simulation-time authority and should not spread into extracted rules.

forbiddenDependencies.statement: Do not introduce UI, bootstrap, Editor, config-asset behavior, singleton service location, reflection, or manager/controller/facade dependencies into boarding simulation.
Do not replace the unmanaged ISystem and Burst job boundary with SystemBase, MonoBehaviour, managed component objects, or direct object instantiate/destroy/find/load APIs.
Do not move query ownership, decision ordering, main-thread stale-decision revalidation, ECB playback, diagnostics, or passenger-state authority into a broad helper.

boundedExtractionCandidates.statement: Extract only duplicated passenger-kind, capacity, and occupancy rules into a stateless Burst-compatible utility with explicit inputs; retain query ownership, ordering, revalidation, ECB playback, diagnostics, and passenger mutation in current owners.
boundedExtractionCandidates.authorityBoundary: The utility owns no state and returns only normalized kind, capacity, or occupancy values from explicit unmanaged inputs.
boundedExtractionCandidates.proposedUpdateOrder: Existing job and main-thread revalidation call sites retain their current order and invoke the same stateless rules.
boundedExtractionCandidates.cleanupAuthority: The utility owns no containers, entities, requests, or lifecycle cleanup.
